fusions.name: Bewildering Pollen
fusions.desc: Blows pollen over up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stunning it for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lure Blossom
fusions.desc: Tosses a sweet-scented blossom at one enemy at or below 30% health; it deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Nettles
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Sundew Tally
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 stacks they all spend at once and heal you for 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% in all). A stack fades every 5 seconds if none is added.
